skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.
skills.description: Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
Steadier hands with any blade.
A frame hardened by work and worse.
Everything behind one blow.
The next blade that finds you meets an answer.
A felled foe quickens the blood.

skills._comment: GH#90 rider: `applies.burning` (2 dmg/round tick, 3 rounds) -- a fire bolt catching cloth/fur alight is the direct fictional read, no reach needed.
skills.description: A hissing dart of goblin fire.
A roaring lance of goblin-fire down the line.
A dart of biting cold that clings to the legs.
Woven mana drinks the blow before flesh does.
The first spell leaves the fingers before the thought finishes.

skills.field_ambient: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.
skills.description: A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
The feet decide before the mind does.
Breath returns, and the body remembers it can go on.
A cold prickle at the neck, a heartbeat before harm.
Thrusts that seek the seams in any guard.
A cut loosed before the guard can rise.
One bright line. The eye catches up too late.
Mid-swing, the blade bends its path toward whatever is unguarded.
Three points of pain in a single breath.
A wide, raking arc that finds an opening no straight thrust could.
For one moment the air is stitched with spearpoints.
A fist-sized spike of ice, hurled hard enough to crack shields.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Icy Floor] -> [Ice Floor] (id `icy_floor` UNCHANGED -- save-compat).
skills.description: The stones glaze over, and footing becomes a rumor.
An arm's-length arc of fire, reaped close.
A snap of light and heat that leaves spots dancing in the eyes.

skills._comment: Instant damage only -- no terrain write, no status write, no expiry seam (contrast icy_floor, which glazes+slows for `duration_rounds`).
skills.description: A ring of fire blooms at the target's feet, then erupts into a roaring pillar.
Mana runs down the blade until the edge sings.

skills._comment: Structurally unreachable by `sim_combat_batch.gd` (spellsword is never assigned in the harness's BUILDS array, same as fire_mage/ice_mage precedent) -- no balance-harness re-run needed.
skills.description: Every spell you have ever cast settles into the strike, and the strike remembers all of them at once.
Chores that would tire another barely slow you.

skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cooking] — You picture the dish this place is missing. Your hands twitch toward a ladle that isn't there.
skills.description: Simple meals come out right, every time.
Trays, kegs, and crates feel lighter than they should.

skills._comment: Canon pass: renamed [Observe] -> [Appraise Foe] (id `observe` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible).
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Foe] — You take in the empty space around you. Nothing here rewards a closer look.
skills.description: A measuring look that reads a room, a person, a problem, and files it away for later.
The whole field resolves into a map. You always know the one step that matters.

skills.field_ambient: [Soothe Clientele] — You offer the empty room a calming word. Only the dust settles.
skills.description: A word and a refilled glass, and the room's troubles ease. Patrons forget whatever was gnawing at them.

skills.field_ambient: [Unerring Aim] — You size up a throw out of habit. Nothing here is worth the toss.
skills.description: Whatever you throw finds its mark: a mug slid down the bar, a rag, or a troublemaker's head.

skills.field_ambient: [Sweep the Tables] — You reach to clear the dishes. The tables here are already bare.
skills.description: A cluttered table comes clean in a single pass, the dishes spirited back to the kitchen.

skills.field_ambient: [Server's Prescience] — You listen for what the room needs next. All quiet, for now.
skills.description: You know what a guest wants before they raise a hand: the empty cup, the missing fork, the order about to be called.

skills.field_ambient: [Charming Smile] — You flash a warm, easy smile at no one in particular. A passing sparrow seems charmed, at least.
skills.description: A warm, disarming smile that puts people at ease and turns a cold first meeting friendly.
A steadying word and a calming hand; the fight drains out of a foe, and their guard turns slow and uncertain.

skills._comment: raskghar_awakened's ONLY skill, so the AI (`_act_ranged`'s spell_id scan) always picks it -- guaranteed real, no dead-code risk, cast almost every turn it's in range.
skills.description: A sweeping, reaching swipe of claw and forearm that batters the legs out from under you and leaves them slow to answer.

skills._comment: Canon rename: [Frost Touch] -> [Snap Freeze] (id `frost_touch` UNCHANGED -- save-compat).
skills.freeze_toast: [Snap Freeze] — You lay your palm to the water and cold spiders out from it. In a breath the channel locks to grey-white ice, thick enough to bear your weight. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Snap Freeze] — Frost blooms from your fingers and hangs glittering in the air. There is nothing here for it to grip.
skills.description: A breath of deep cold that skins still water in load-bearing ice.

skills._comment: Canon rename: [Kindle] -> [Firefly] (id `kindle` UNCHANGED -- save-compat).
skills.field_ambient: [Firefly] — A curl of flame dances up over your knuckles and gutters out. Nothing here will take the fire.
skills.description: A conjured flame, hot enough to take dry debris and old timber in moments.

skills._comment: Canon rename (closes the provisional naming AND the real class grant): [Sneak] -> [Stealth] (id `sneak` UNCHANGED -- save-compat; ids are never player-visible, verified by grep -- no UI surface renders a raw id).
skills.description: A soft step that slips past watching eyes and clears ground when blades are drawn.

skills._comment: COEXISTENCE CONTRACT (unchanged): [Stealth] and [Invisibility] both flip the SAME single field `sneaking` bool -- one stance, two keys.
skills.description: A working that bends the light around you until even a careful eye finds nothing worth watching.

skills._comment: GH#94 icon drain: icon_power_shot added (code-drawn fletched-arrow glyph, tools/sync_assets.py::_draw_placeholder shape 'arrow_power').
skills.description: A full draw, held a breath too long, loosed dead center.

skills._comment: GH#70 [Archer].
skills.description: Nock, draw, loose -- before the first arrow lands, the second is already gone.

skills._comment: Reuses line_damage VERBATIM (flame_jet's own effect type/resolver, WISkillEffects._resolve_line_damage) -- an arrow that overpenetrates instead of a jet of fire, weapon-gated to bow instead of element-gated.
skills.description: One arrow, and everything in its path pays the same price.

skills._comment: Deliberately NOT the same skill id as `observe` (a distinct grant, not a re-grant of Tactician's [Appraise Foe]) -- no combat effect, exploration-only, contexts/field/field_ambient shape copied from `observe` verbatim.
skills.field_ambient: [Keen Eye] — You read the room the way you'd read a stand of trees for game: what moved, what didn't, what's worth a second look. Nothing here needs tracking.
skills.description: A hunter's habit of noticing: the broken twig, the wrong shadow, the one thing that doesn't belong.

skills._comment: Enemy-only (vault_construct, data/combatants.json) -- no class grants it.
skills.description: A vast fist draws back, and the floor itself seems to brace.

skills._comment: Id `directed_strike` is PINNED (Lane B builds against it) and unchanged -- only display_name substitutes, the same id-stable/display-swap convention sneak->[Stealth]/observe->[Appraise Foe] already established.
skills.description: You read the opening before it's there, and the blow lands exactly where it was always going to.
A half-step that puts you exactly where the fight isn't looking.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- no wiki match found; mirrors [Battlefield Awareness]'s own unflagged precedent (Tactician's L1 grant, same idiom).
skills.description: The whole board resolves at once -- every gap in a guard, every foot planted wrong.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match.
skills.field_ambient: [Measured Words] — You turn a careful phrase to no one in particular. It lands, as it always does, on empty air.
skills.description: Every word chosen and weighed before it leaves the mouth -- the kind of care that opens doors a blunt tongue never finds.

skills._comment: Costs MP unlike second_wind (a genuine resource tax distinguishing the two self/ally heals) and heals less (6 vs second_wind's 8) since it can reach a second body.
skills.description: A calm that isn't performed -- it settles over the room, and over a hurting friend, the same way.

skills._comment: AP-only (no mp_cost, a construct's ward isn't a spell) -- a small mend plus a defensive ward is the direct read for an escort construct covering its hurt sibling/boss.
skills.description: A muttered ward and a steadying hand -- the hurt eases, and the next blow lands a little softer.

skills.field_ambient: [Open Doors] — You offer the easy, practiced warmth that opens rooms. There is no room here to open.
skills.description: Doors that would stay shut for anyone else swing open at your approach -- goodwill has its own kind of key.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect index), no match for a bare trap-sense Skill.
skills.field_ambient: [Find Trap] — You scan the ground and walls out of old habit. Nothing here is rigged.
skills.description: A practiced eye for the telltale signs of a trap: a loose stone, a taut wire, a floor that doesn't quite match.

skills._comment: Field-only, same requires_skill+on_skill_use seam, no new sim code.
skills.field_ambient: [Disarm Trap] — Your fingers twitch through the motions of a disarm. There is nothing here to still.
skills.description: Steady hands and a thief's patience: whatever waits to spring, waits a little longer.

skills._comment: Id `sudden_strike` is PINNED and unchanged -- only display_name substitutes.
skills.description: One chance, taken before the fight knows to expect it.

skills._comment: Id PINNED.
skills.description: A shot picked out in advance, and placed exactly there.

skills._comment: Id PINNED.
skills.description: A punishing volley loosed down the line, arrow after arrow finding the same seam.

skills._comment: flame_jet stays untouched (still the only line-shaped fire skill); this is the practical EARLY single-target active fire lacked entirely.
skills.description: A guttering mote of flame flung hard and fast, spent before it can gutter out.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked (Skills Effect/P), no match for a bare hospitality-themed Skill.
skills.field_ambient: [Perfect Hospitality] — You straighten a chair, smooth a cloth, ready the room out of habit. There's no one here to welcome yet.
skills.description: Every guest finds exactly the welcome they didn't know they needed -- a warm room, a full glass, a seat that was somehow already theirs.

skills._comment: `weapon: bow` gates it through the SAME `weapon_gated_kit` filter every other weapon-tagged skill already uses, so it only ever contributes with a bow equipped -- the 'bow passive' framing holds exactly.
skills.description: Breath out, string back, and the point of aim simply stops drifting -- a drawn bow held as still as a nail in a beam.

skills._comment: Deliberately carries NEITHER `ap_cost`/`effect` NOR `field: true` -- a pure passive identity trait, the SAME shape lesser_stamina/lesser_strength already ship (flavor-only, never castable).
skills.description: An instinct for what a price is REALLY worth, and the nerve to say so out loud. Where haggling is welcome, the asking price comes down for you.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- wiki-checked, no match.
skills.field_ambient: [Appraise Goods] — You turn an imagined item over in your hands out of habit, weighing a price that isn't there.
skills.description: A trader's eye: where a thing came from, what it's really worth, and whether the asking price is honest.

skills._comment: No `ap_cost`/`effect`/`field` -- same passive-identity shape as bargain above.
skills.description: Wholesale eyes on a retail world -- goods move through you in bulk, and the numbers favor the one who moves them.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- passive-identity shape matches bargain/lesser_stamina.
skills.description: The road is long. Your legs have stopped caring.

skills.description: The opening between one step and the next becomes a road of its own.

skills.description: Root, leaf, patience, and the exact moment the pot should leave the fire.

skills.description: A quiet promise laid over skin and spirit: not this one, not yet.

skills.description: One hard look catches like a curse, and certainty drains from the target's limbs.

skills.field_ambient: [Detect Magic] — You open your senses. No nearby working answers.
skills.description: Magic leaves pressure, color, and intent behind. You have learned how to look.

skills.description: A kitchen becomes possibility: timing, balance, and the dish hidden inside the ingredients.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ATTESTED -- Erin, 2.17; passive-identity shape limited to recipes and practiced arts.

skills.field_ambient: [Signature Dish] — The dish is already clear in your mind. Only the kitchen is missing.
skills.description: One dish bears your hand so completely that no other cook could make it the same.

skills.field_ambient: [Eagle Eyes] — Distance sharpens, but there is no vantage here worth claiming.
skills.description: Distance gives up its secrets: tracks, motion, and the one detail that does not belong.

skills._comment: CANON-VERDICT: ORIGINAL, canon-plausible flag -- sudden_strike's once-per-fight numbers with a bow gate.
skills.description: You choose the quarry before drawing. The arrow only completes the decision.
